The Burning Godzilla Selvedge is part of our official Godzilla® collaboration, this time inspired by one of the most iconic and volatile versions of the character, Burning Godzilla, from the 1995 film Godzilla vs. Destoroyah (ゴジラVSデストロイア).
In that film, Godzilla reaches a critical point. His heart functions like a nuclear reactor, and it’s in meltdown mode. His skin glows with radioactive heat, veins of fire running across his body, and his Heat Ray transforms into the devastating Burning Heat Ray (バーニング熱線 Bāningu Nessen). It’s one of the most striking designs in the franchise and one of the most emotionally charged endings in kaiju cinema.
